files.installs/necesse/gamedash-test-run.sh:
#!/bin/bash
# gamedash-managed Necesse server — generated by provision().
# World, settings and logs: <ROOT>/installs/necesse/gamedash-servers/test
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
CONSOLE="<ROOT>/installs/necesse/gamedash-servers/test/gamedash-console.log.console"
: > "$CONSOLE"
cd "<ROOT>/installs/necesse" || exit 1
# The server's console is fed from the file above, so the dashboard can type
# commands into it (save, say, stop).
exec ./jre/bin/java -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=50 -jar Server.jar -nogui \
    -datadir "<ROOT>/installs/necesse/gamedash-servers/test" -world "test" -port 14159 -slots 10 \
    -password "$GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD" -pausewhenempty 1 -logging 1 \
    > "<ROOT>/installs/necesse/gamedash-servers/test/gamedash-console.log" 2>&1 < <(tail -n0 -F "$CONSOLE")
files.installs/necesse/gamedash-test-stop.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# gamedash-managed graceful stop: ask the server to save and quit, then wait.
echo "stop" >> "<ROOT>/installs/necesse/gamedash-servers/test/gamedash-console.log.console"
i=0
while [ $i -lt 45 ] && pgrep -f -- '-datadir <ROOT>/installs/necesse/gamedash-servers/test' >/dev/null; do sleep 1; i=$((i+1)); done
exit 0
